description: Source code implementing ARM Cortex-M security and MPU region management functions for Zephyr OS, including secure/nonsecure region retrieval and address permission checks.

methods.name: arm_cmse_mpu_region_get
methods.description: Retrieves the MPU region for a given address.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_readwrite_ok
methods.description: Checks if address is readable and writable.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_range_read_ok
methods.description: Checks if address range is readable.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_range_readwrite_ok
methods.description: Checks if address range is readable and writable.

methods.name: arm_cmse_mpu_nonsecure_region_get
methods.description: Retrieves the nonsecure MPU region for a given address (if CONFIG_ARM_SECURE_FIRMWARE is defined).

methods.name: arm_cmse_sau_region_get
methods.description: Retrieves the SAU region for a given address (if CONFIG_ARM_SECURE_FIRMWARE is defined).

methods.name: arm_cmse_idau_region_get
methods.description: Retrieves the IDAU region for a given address (if CONFIG_ARM_SECURE_FIRMWARE is defined).

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_is_secure
methods.description: Checks if an address is in secure memory.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_nonsecure_read_ok
methods.description: Checks if a nonsecure address is readable.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_nonsecure_readwrite_ok
methods.description: Checks if a nonsecure address is readable and writable.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_range_nonsecure_read_ok
methods.description: Checks if a nonsecure address range is readable.

methods.name: arm_cmse_addr_range_nonsecure_readwrite_ok
methods.description: Checks if a nonsecure address range is readable and writable.
